VERSION 9.96.0 (new file over 9.95.1; the repair of the sys.modules leak): the boot program imports pypdf, python-docx, Pillow, lxml and cryptography and snapshots every module of them; before AND after every program (the worker's _restore wrapped once, lazily, from _before_run) it puts the working folder, those modules in sys.modules (a None entry becomes the real module again) and their module attributes back, and as a general guard deletes every sys.modules entry that is None and was not None at start (the name of a real module of the start is put back). The cause: the example ImagesNeedPillow sets sys.modules['PIL'] = None and restores it in a finally block; a variant of it with one token blanked raised before that block and left PIL at None for every later program that imports PIL.
